question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Ebb
solution:
The correct answer is: **Flow.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ebb** means a recurrent pattern of going down or decline.(अवनति)

** •* Example- ****Consumer confidence is currently at a low **ebb.***

 
• Marked option **Flow** means a steady, continuous movement of something/somebody.(प्रवाह)

** •* Example- ****A **flow** of words is no proof of wisdom.*

 
• It is clear that **Ebb** and **Flow** are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ripe** means ready for something or in a suitable state for something.(पका हुआ)
 
• **Moisture** means water in small drops on a surface, in the air, etc.(नमी)
 
• **Stiff **means firm and difficult to bend or move.(अकड़न)
